notes.en: Subbasin areas use the upstream raster definition. Topological level differs from Strahler order. Spatial outputs alone do not establish model readiness.
notes.zh: 子流域面积为上游栅格口径；拓扑层级不同于 Strahler 河流等级。空间成果不代表模型整体已具备运行条件。

notes.en: One-to-many subbasin/reach mappings are allowed; see detail tables.
notes.zh: 子流域与河段可存在一对多映射；完整关系见明细表。
